title: Parameterized tests
summary: test.each repeats one rule for a table of examples. This reduces repeated test code while keeping cases visible.
introduction: test.each repeats one rule for a table of examples. This reduces repeated test code while keeping cases visible. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: test.each repeats one rule for a table of examples. This reduces repeated test code while keeping cases visible.

blocks.code:
import { test, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from "vitest";
test.each([[1, 1], [2, 4], [3, 9]])("square %i", (input, expected) => { expect(input * input).toBe(expected); });

blocks.text: A test table should include useful edge cases, not only easy positive inputs.
